item.summary: Provisions for Amnesty were introduced as a transitional measure in the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) Scheme 2026, notified on 29.06.2026. These provisions offer a one-time opportunity for regularisation of exemption status of Provident Fund (PF) Trusts that are recognized under the Income Tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961), but lack a formal exemption order granted under section 17 of the…
item.title: Retrospective regularization of exempt status of Provident Fund (PF) Trusts through Amnesty Scheme, 2026
